items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I did The Flip Wilson Show... and The Carol Burnett Show, I did some Fender bass on there.

ctx.x: I didn't know that. I've never seen you with one.

Well, I own one, and I've... Well, I did The Flip Wilson Show, that was four years of Fender bass; and The Carol Burnett Show, I did some Fender bass on there. But I have to say that I was never in love with the Fender
